content.value_statement: Unity projects often struggle with performance, platform differences, and maintainable architecture. This skill provides practical Unity guidance for C#, rendering, assets, UI, testing, and deployment.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Unity project architecture for gameplay, UI, services, and scalable team workflows.
Guides performance optimization with Unity Profiler, memory analysis, rendering checks, and platform constraints.
Plans C# gameplay systems using patterns such as pooling, state machines, ECS, and dependency management.
Advises on URP, HDRP, shaders, lighting, post-processing, and graphics pipeline tradeoffs.
Supports asset, addressable content, build, testing, and deployment workflow planning.
limitations: Does not run the Unity Editor or inspect scenes unless the host tool provides project access.
Cannot validate console certification, store policy approval, or platform SDK access.
May need current Unity package documentation for newly released APIs.
Does not replace profiling on target hardware for final performance decisions.

use_cases.title: Plan a Scalable Game Architecture
use_cases.description: Design gameplay, UI, services, and asset systems before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Improve Runtime Performance
use_cases.description: Identify likely CPU, GPU, memory, physics, and rendering bottlenecks in a Unity project.

use_cases.title: Prepare Cross-Platform Builds
use_cases.description: Create practical build, testing, input, UI, and deployment plans for multiple target platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Unity Feature Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Unity feature idea and suggest a simple implementation plan, required systems, and testing checks.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Gameplay System
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Unity gameplay system for CPU, memory, physics, and allocation risks. Recommend practical improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Design Cross-Platform UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Unity UI approach for mobile, PC, and console. Include input handling, scaling, accessibility, and test coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Architect a Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production Unity pipeline for assets, addressables, automated builds, testing, profiling, and release management.

output_examples.input: Optimize a mobile Unity project that has frame drops during combat.
output_examples.output: A prioritized checklist covering profiler captures, pooling, physics cost, texture memory, URP settings, overdraw, and device testing.

output_examples.input: Plan a multiplayer Unity prototype for a small team.
output_examples.output: A system design covering network authority, synchronization, lobby flow, data ownership, testing milestones, and rollout risks.

output_examples.input: Prepare a Unity project for PC and Android release.
output_examples.output: A release plan covering platform settings, input differences, asset compression, QA matrix, performance targets, and build automation.

best_practices: Share target platforms, Unity version, render pipeline, and performance goals before asking for architecture advice.
Use profiler data, device details, and reproduction steps when requesting optimization guidance.
Ask for testing and rollback plans when changing build, asset, or deployment workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic Unity advice without project constraints or target hardware.
Do not apply optimization changes without measuring before and after results.
Do not treat generated plans as certification or store submission approval.

faq.question: Can this skill write Unity C# scripts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help plan and draft gameplay, UI, tools, and performance-focused C# scripts.

faq.question: Does it support Unity 6 LTS?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is written for Unity 6 LTS concepts and modern Unity workflows.

faq.question: Can it choose between URP and HDRP?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare render pipeline tradeoffs using platform, visual quality, and performance requirements.

faq.question: Can it fix performance problems automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can recommend changes, but real validation requires profiling and testing on target hardware.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Is it useful for non-game Unity projects?
faq.answer: Yes. Many architecture, rendering, UI, performance, and deployment practices apply to simulations and interactive apps.
